The '''kolvissh''' was a kind of flowering [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] once used some for [[Gender/Legends|her]] bridal veil.
